section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single online study conducted via the Prolific Academic website with a final sample of 315 US participants (151 women, 164 men). It reports demographic details including mean age (M = 32.55), mean self-reported BMI (M = 25.85), racial composition (88.9% White), and educational qualifications (44.9% undergraduate, 18.2% postgraduate; college-or-higher = 63.1%). No instruments for assessing body appreciation (BAS or BAS-2) or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported in this section.
